answer_2.quote: To compute word error rate (WER), we add up the number of insertions, deletions, and errors, and divide by the total number of tokens in the aligned list.

answer_4.quote: we collect three human judgments from Prolific annotators on a subset of 2,000 candidate entities in context.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label one target entity at a time, see the podcast description, episode description, and 300 words of the transcript, and provide a judgment of HOST, GUEST, or NEITHER.
